import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem odd_multiple_period_mod_add_one {a n : ℕ}   :
  ∀ q : ℕ, ((a : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ (n * (2 * q + 1)) = -1) := by
  have h : ((a ^ n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) = 0 := ZMod.natCast_self (a ^ n + 1)
  push_cast at h
  have h1 : (a : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ n = -1 := by linear_combination h
  intro q
  induction q with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : n * (2 * 0 + 1) = n := by ring
    rw [h0, h1]
  | succ q ih =>
    have h2 : n * (2 * (q + 1) + 1) = n * (2 * q + 1) + n * 2 := by ring
    rw [h2, pow_add, ih]
    have h3 : (a : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ (n * 2) = 1 := by
      rw [pow_mul, h1]
      ring
    rw [h3, mul_one]

  intro q
  have h_an : (a : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ n = -1 := by

    have hcast : ((a ^ n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) = (a : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ n + 1 := by
      push_cast
      rfl
    have h0 : (a : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ n + 1 = 0 := by
      rw [← hcast]
      exact hm
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h0

    rw [pow_mul]
  rw [h_pow_mul, h_an]
  have h_odd : Odd (2 * q + 1) := ⟨q, rfl⟩
  exact h_odd.neg_one_pow

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem odd_multiple_period_mod_add_one {a n : ℕ}   :
  ∀ q : ℕ, ((a : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ (n * (2 * q + 1)) = -1) := by
  intro q
  have hz : ((a ^ n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) = 0 :=
    ZMod.natCast_self _
  have hz' : ((a ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) + 1 = 0 := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hz
  have hc : ((a ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) = -1 := by
    linear_combination hz'
  have h : (a : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ n = -1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hc
  calc
    (a : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ (n * (2 * q + 1)) =
        ((a : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ n) ^ (2 * q + 1) := by
          rw [pow_mul]
    _ = (-1 : ZMod (a ^ n + 1)) ^ (2 * q + 1) := by
          rw [h]
    _ = -1 := by
          rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
          norm_num
